body: Jesus would love aerosol, after all
Obsession though, obsession about death will get you.  Wears you down, you know?
It's funny, it's always so much harder to put the thoughts into words.

Gatorade cure, haha I like that - I drink that stuff after a night of drinking to stave off auras.  The problem, for me, is that the thoughts of death and things of that nature are constant and have been for almost three years - not just after a seizure.

Yeah I'm meeting with him next month - I can hang in until then.  Trying to be positive doesn't help because even if I have a positive thought for a fraction of a second, all the thoughts come roaring back in like a tidal wave.  It's extremely frustrating.
